lines.2: That put me on exactly the same level as Crab and the others.
lines.3: 「Nice! Make sure you give me some too!」
lines.5: 「That's the best part! It's all crispy and delicious!」
lines.6: What? She was actually happy with the skin?!
lines.8: 「But that wasn't the reaction I was hoping for. How boring.」
lines.9: How should I know what reaction she wanted?
